body:
Leah W: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need owners and clear timing for the customer-facing outputs—mini statuspage blurb, a plain-language incident summary, and the policy for sharing full RCAs.
Dinesh P: I can take the statuspage blurb and short summary draft. Will keep the page copy 1-2 lines and the summary <300 words. ETA: tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Irene C: Support will prepare an affected-account list and flag SLA customers. Ill have that by EOD today and mark impact tiers.
Sam B: Ops question: publish the short status blurb immediately for transparency or wait until the sanitized summary is ready?
Legal Team: Short blurb is fine to publish now. Anything with customer identifiers, raw logs, or internal traces must be redacted and only shared after a review and a signed DSA if necessary. We will provide a redaction checklist and a standard "how to request more" paragraph.
Dinesh P: I'll include a "request more details" line pointing to Support and note that detailed appendices require authorization.
Leah W: Let's also decide outreach cadence: SLA customers get a proactive email within 24h; all affected accounts see the sanitized summary via status page + ticket within 48h.
Irene C: Agreed. I'll prepare templates for the SLA email to speed AM outreach.
Sam B: Also proposing a recurring follow-up: for every Sev1/Sev2 we run a 72h check to see if the public summary needs an update (mitigation changes, permanent fix timeline). Adds a follow-up owner to the action tracker.
Legal Team: Sounds good. We'll add that to the redaction checklist and provide sample language for follow-up updates.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-211 moved to postmortem by @leahw at 2026-03-27T14:11:02Z.
Leah W: Action items: Dinesh -> statuspage + short summary draft by 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Irene -> affected list + SLA flags by EOD today. Legal -> redaction checklist + request-template by COB tomorrow. Sam -> add recurring 72h public-summary review to action tracker. I'll log these and run a mid-week check-in. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
